title: T P M T and thiopurine dosing

segs.text: Section fifteen. T P M T and genotype guided thiopurine dosing. T P M T, thiopurine methyltransferase, sends six mercaptopurine to an inactive product, six methylmercaptopurine. When T P M T activity is low, more of the dose becomes the active six thioguanine nucleotides, six T G N. These stop dividing cells, blood cells included. The white count drops, and a standard dose can cause fatal myelosuppression. Hair loss and gastrointestinal distress happen for a related reason: those cells divide rapidly, and the drug cannot tell them from cancer cells. So low T P M T means more toxicity, not drug failure.

The common variant alleles are star three A and star three C. Star three A, seen in Caucasians, is a haplotype of two non synonymous snips; about five percent of people are heterozygous and about one in three hundred homozygous. Star three C, seen in East Asians, is one snip in the coding region.

Before genotyping, the phenotype came from T P M T activity in red blood cells, and doses were adjusted from that. When patients are grouped by activity, homozygous wild type people form the largest group at the highest activity, heterozygotes a smaller intermediate group, and homozygous variant patients a very small group with the lowest activity. She said, you can't assume that the wild type is always in the middle.

Wild type patients get the full mercaptopurine dose. Heterozygotes get about thirty five percent, less than half. Homozygous deficient patients all need a reduction and tolerate less than ten percent. The thiopurines were the first drugs for which the F D A held public hearings on putting pharmacogenetic information in the label. Genotyping first is now the standard of care; she said you could be considered negligent if you did not know your patient's T P M T status.

Work by Cheok and Evans shows why. With the same dose for everyone, patients with two variant copies have very high six T G N and the most toxicity. With individualized doses, six T G N and toxicity are similar and low in all groups.
